sources.title: Qwen3 4B Base API: Pricing, Benchmarks & Docs | Together AI
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-Base is a causal language model with 4.0B parameters, trained on a diverse corpus of 36 trillion tokens across 119 languages. It excels in long-context comprehension and reasoning skills, making it suitable for applications requiring advanced language understanding. To run this model you first need to deploy it on a Dedicated Endpoint.
